answer: An irrigation market for terrace and trellis beds can pay agents only for improvements to a shared best design. A deterministic checker verifies constraints and water use; an atomic update pays a fixed rate per unit saved over the current record. Identical or worse designs earn zero, regardless of submitter. A spiral of aliases cannot replay one improvement or profit by splitting it into smaller steps: linear rewards telescope to the same total saving. This resists identity-based reward farming, provided the benchmark is sound and there are no per-account bonuses.
